theorem moduleCup_derived_tensor_connectivity (F G : C) :
    (((singleFunctor C 0).obj F) ⊗ ((singleFunctor C 0).obj G)).IsLE 0

title: Connectivity of the derived tensor
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with monoidal additivity, functorial flat resolutions and a derived category. For F,G in C the derived tensor of their degree-zero singleFunctor objects is in D≤0.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Section 20.31; derived tensor construction used in Lemma 20.31.3

proof.text: Specialize the upstream proved DerivedCategory.isLE_tensor in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.FlatModel to (singleFunctor C 0).obj F, (singleFunctor C 0).obj G and bounds 0,0. The single objects have IsLE 0 by instance synthesis. simpa reduces 0+0 to 0. This is the complete one-line Lean specialization, not a new flat-resolution construction.

proof_origin.place: DerivedCategory.isLE_tensor, specialized to degree-zero singleFunctor objects and bounds 0,0 by simpa
